comments.body:
Looks good. The Windows 3.11 failure is a network flake (GitHub clone timed out on `dataclass-factory`), not this change.

One nit: `do_uninstall` doesn't call `ensure_project`, so without a virtualenv `_uninstall_from_environment` returns `False` from the `not is_active` branch without printing anything. With this PR, `pipenv uninstall foo` in a project with no virtualenv would update the Pipfile and then exit 1 silently. Could you print a short message in that branch (for example "No virtualenv found; {package} was removed from the Pipfile but not uninstalled") so the non-zero exit has an explanation?

Thanks for the review. Added the message in that branch: without a virtualenv, `_uninstall_from_environment` now prints "No virtualenv found; {package} was removed from the Pipfile but not uninstalled." before returning `False`, so the non-zero exit has an explanation. A unit test covers it.

This comment was drafted with the help of an AI agent (Claude) working on behalf of the PR author.
